prompt: Can you check this repo for SQL injection and XSS vulnerabilities?
why: Canonical trigger, English trigger-led description. Baseline recall — if this misses, nothing downstream is trustworthy.

prompt: Add a Dapper query using DynamicParameters to this repository class.
why: Names the library and an API from its description.

prompt: This EF Core query is slow, I think it is an N+1.
why: Its description ends with the literal symptom 'fix N+1'.

prompt: jest.mock is not hoisting and my ESM transform fails.
why: Two symptoms quoted verbatim from its description.

prompt: EXPLAIN shows a seq scan on this table; help me choose an index.
why: Deep perf tuning is explicitly routed here, not to postgresql-best-practices.

prompt: 我要重構 FileProcess，先幫我列出依賴方。
why: zh-TW trigger keyword 重構 is listed in its 觸發關鍵字. Step 2's zh-TW regex work only proves the description LOOKS trigger-led; this proves it FIRES.

prompt: 剛剛那個測試失敗修好了，收尾一下。
why: zh-TW post-fix trigger; description says 之後觸發.

prompt: 這個 bug 每次跑都重現，幫我診斷根因。
why: zh-TW phrasing of an English-described skill — the mixed-language case the static lint cannot see at all.

prompt: 幫我設計這張 MySQL schema，utf8mb4 跟 InnoDB 有什麼要注意？
why: zh-TW prompt, English description, both nouns from the description.

prompt: Set up a pre-commit hook that blocks leaked secrets before they are committed.
why: Its own description routes CI/pre-commit gates to dependency-security-scan. Firing here is the documented boundary being ignored.

prompt: My userEvent.click does nothing and the RTL query returns null.
why: Its description ends 'RTL queries/userEvent -> testing-library-react-best-practices'.

prompt: Tune this query plan and pick a partition strategy for a 2TB table.
why: Description hands deep perf tuning to postgresql-optimization.

prompt: Fix these Tailwind v4 shadcn token colours in dark mode.
why: Description ends 'Tailwind v4 + shadcn tokens -> tailwind-v4-shadcn'.

prompt: My Pinia store state resets between route changes.
why: Description explicitly excludes Pinia state, routing it to pinia.

prompt: Add an EF Core migration for this DbContext.
why: Adjacent .NET data access, different tool. Tests that 'data access' alone is not the trigger.

prompt: Rewrite this one skill's description so it fires more reliably.
why: Its own 'Not for' line: one skill rather than a folder routes to writing-great-skills.

prompt: 新增一個獨立的 helper 檔案，目前沒有任何人引用它。
why: Its description grants an explicit skip for pure additions. A zh-TW false-positive probe: 檔案 alone must not trigger it.

prompt: Audit my whole skills folder and tell me which ones to delete.
why: Mirror of quiet-auditing-single-skill. Both directions must hold or the pair is a collision, not a routing rule.

prompt: Audit my dependencies for known CVEs and generate an SBOM in CI.
why: Documented split against security-review. Only observable with every skill loaded — this is the empirical form of Step 2b.

prompt: My React Testing Library getByRole returns null right after userEvent.type.
why: Paired with quiet-jest-rtl: one prompt, two skills, the transcript names the winner.

prompt: Set up container queries and @layer for this responsive grid.
why: Paired with quiet-css-tailwind. Native CSS features stay with css-ui-best-practices.

prompt: 把這次的進度整理成 handoff 給下一個 session。
why: EXPECTED TO SKIP, not to pass. handoff sets disable-model-invocation: true, so it can never auto-fire on Claude. The row exists to prove the runner reports that as SKIP rather than scoring a false miss against the description.

prompt: Implement the plan we agreed on, TDD, red first.
why: Second SKIP row on purpose: this key is honoured only by Claude. Codex reads agents/openai.yaml and Copilot ignores it entirely, so the same case scores differently per host and must never be silently folded into a single number.
